title: fix(mcp): use the standard MP3 MIME type in generateText audio blocks
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: MCP generateText audio blocks now label MP3 output as audio/mpeg, including when MP3 is the default format, so clients receive the standard MIME type. Other format labels, audio data and transcripts remain unchanged. A handler regression test checks the returned MP3 block.
